# Sutra Haus

> Sutra Haus is an independent, owner-led design studio for hospitality and
> consumer brands. It rebuilds websites into fast, booking-first experiences,
> art-directs original imagery for social channels, and produces short-form
> film. Nothing is template-based: every website and image is designed from
> zero in the client's own visual language. The studio is based in India and
> works worldwide.

## Facts

- Business name: Sutra Haus
- Principal: Badal Kariwal
- Contact: badal@sutrahaus.com
- Website: https://sutrahaus.com/
- Base: India — working worldwide, remote-first
- Clients: hotels, resorts and hospitality groups (independent properties to
  international chains) and consumer / e-commerce brands
- Registered Indian business; GST details available on request

## Engagements

- The Rebuild: a complete redesign and build of the client's website —
  bespoke design, fast mobile-first engineering, booking-engine integration
  with live direct-vs-OTA rate display, search & AI-search readiness, and
  managed hosting (client always owns domain and content).
- The Programme: The Rebuild plus a continuous monthly supply of art-directed
  imagery for the brand's channels, seasonal and campaign sets, and grid
  direction.
- The Partnership: an embedded creative studio — web, imagery and short-form
  film under one roof, with a standing content calendar and priority
  turnaround.
- Every conversation begins with a complimentary concept: the client's
  homepage, reimagined, before any commitment.

## Proof of work

- Hospitality: complete digital rebuild for a landmark sixty-key hotel in
  Eastern India — two websites, direct-booking flow with live OTA rate
  comparison (direct rates currently about 30% lower), Google Lighthouse
  mobile scores in the 90s, and 125+ original social creatives in a visual
  language invented for the property. Shown publicly in excerpts only;
  the full case is shared privately on request.
- Consumer / e-commerce: Ephoria (https://ephoria.store), a wellness brand
  built end-to-end by the studio — name, identity, packaging system,
  ten-product line, e-commerce store, photography and all content.

## Policy on client work

Client websites and channels belong to the clients. The public site shows
excerpts only; the complete folio (full sites, feeds and film) is shared
privately, with permission, via badal@sutrahaus.com.

## How to engage

Email badal@sutrahaus.com. The studio studies the current website and
channels, then presents a complimentary reimagined homepage concept before
any commitment.
